decision.candidate: A Loom KV block copy, gather, scatter, compact, or remap operator for vLLM V1 default prefix caching and preemption
decision.reason: vLLM 0.24 reuses prefix blocks logically and handles default preemption by freeing blocks and recomputing. The exercised scheduler path exposes no physical KV movement boundary for Loom to accelerate.

accepted: A real Qwen2.5-0.5B vLLM V1 run observed a 1,024-token prefix-cache hit.
A capacity-pressure run observed three real scheduler preemptions.
Neither path called the instrumented swap or batch-copy entrypoints.
excluded: Optional CPU KV offload was not configured or benchmarked.
Distributed KV transfer, beam-search movement, and another engine's cache policy were not benchmarked.
The recorded latencies are workload diagnostics, not Loom or vLLM performance claims.

scope.engine_path: vLLM V1 default local GPU KV cache

source_contract.prefix_cache: KVCacheManager.get_computed_blocks finds already-computed full blocks and returns their logical block references.
source_contract.preemption: Scheduler._preempt_request frees request blocks, sets num_computed_tokens to zero, increments num_preemptions, and returns the request to the waiting queue.
source_contract.optional_offload: The separate offload paths already select cuMemcpyBatchAsync or a tuned Triton small-copy path and require their own workload before Loom admission.

command: CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-13.1 env -u PYTHONPATH -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH -u LOOM_KERNELS_TORCH_LIBRARY <fresh-python> benchmarks/vllm_kv_movement_admission.py --model /workspace/models/qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct --gpu-memory-utilization 0.03 --max-model-len 2048 --max-num-seqs 96 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --prefix-tokens 1024 --preemption-batch-size 96 --preemption-input-tokens 1536 --preemption-output-tokens 64 --enforce-eager --cache-root <isolated-cache> --result-json <result.json>

interpretation.admission: Do not add a default vLLM prefix/preemption KV-movement API or CUDA kernel to Loom.
interpretation.roadmap: Move deterministic counter-based sampling RNG to the next implementation slot.
interpretation.revisit_condition: Reopen KV movement only for a named offload, beam, compaction, or other engine path whose profile shows material physical movement not already owned efficiently by the CUDA driver or engine.
